subject: MAP & prompt-pack handoff: evaluation samples, access windows, and close cadence
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@retaillytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@retaillytics.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Eval exchange: request for MAP + sample prompt pack

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising for our web search reranking workload. Wed like to move forward with a short evaluation: Retaillytics wants a two-week onramp to validate prompt coverage and regression behavior. To proceed we need:

- A mutual action plan (MAP) that lists milestones and acceptance gates.
- Temporary access to a curated prompt pack and the associated testcases (read-only).
- Usage constraints: data must remain in your ephemeral sandbox; we cannot permit export of testcases.
- Evidence of SOC2 coverage for the sandbox environment.

Can your team draft a MAP and share the prompt pack (zipped) plus metadata? Wed also like a simple acceptance checklist (pass/fail criteria per testcase).

Target timeline from our side: start the eval week of Apr 26 and finish acceptance by May 10. If thats workable, what do you need from us to finalize the MAP?

Best,
Elena Torres
Principal PM, Retaillytics
elena.torres@retaillytics.com

Attachment: Retaillytics_requirements_20270414.pdf (PDF)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@retaillytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval exchange: request for MAP + sample prompt pack

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can support the two-week onramp and will respect the read-only/export restrictions. Below is a proposed MAP outline and immediate next steps; Ill attach the artifacts for your review.

Proposed high-level MAP (milestones & owners):
1) MAP sign-off (owner: Retaillytics PM / Redwood Sales) — target Apr 21
2) Artifact delivery & sandbox access (owner: Redwood Onboarding) — Apr 22 (prompt pack + testcases metadata)
3) Hand-off call / walk-through of testcases (owner: Redwood Solutions Eng) — Apr 26
4) Acceptance run & evidence capture (owner: Retaillytics QA / Redwood) — Apr 26 to May 3
5) Final acceptance review & close (owner: Retaillytics Product Lead / Redwood Sales) — target May 10

Usage & custody constraints (summary):
- Artifacts provided under limited-use eval license: cannot be exported or redistributed.
- Sandbox access will be ephemeral (14 days) and isolated to a single VPC project.
- We will retain only aggregated telemetry; raw testcases will not be logged.

Attachments Im sending with this message:
- Retaillytics_Eval_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft with milestone dates, sign-off flow, acceptance checklist)
- promptpack_v2.zip (zipped prompts; readme inside describes categories and seed cases)
- testcases_metadata.csv (CSV with testcase ids, input type, expected label, pass criteria)

Immediate asks for your side to finalize the MAP:
- Confirm the Apr 26 start for the hand-off call (30-45m).
- Provide names/emails for the two reviewers who will run acceptance (we need to add them to sandbox ACLs).
- Confirm you accept the limited-use license and the no-export clause.

If all good Ill initiate a DocuSign MPA (light-weight) and trigger artifact upload to a shared Drive link (read-only for Retaillytics reviewers). Marissa / Ben / Karthik are looped for operational support.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: Retaillytics_Eval_MAP_v1.pdf; promptpack_v2.zip; testcases_metadata.csv

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@retaillytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@retaillytics.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval exchange: request for MAP + sample prompt pack

Jonas — thanks for the rapid turnaround and for drafting the MAP. A few quick notes from our legal and QA teams: 

- Well need the no-export clause to explicitly include downstream model training (i.e., Retaillytics cannot use these testcases to fine-tune models outside the sandbox).
- Request a 30-day retention window for any aggregated telemetry (acceptable) but request deletion confirmation once the sandbox is torn down.
- We will require a SOC2 AICPA report (or link to your security evidence portal) before we accept the artifact upload.

Operational asks:
- Hand-off call on Apr 26 at 10:00am PT works for us.
- Reviewers: Elena Torres (elena.torres@retaillytics.com), Samir Patel (samir.patel@retaillytics.com)

Were good to sign a light MPA — will have a couple of narrow redlines on the usage clause. Can you route the DocuSign to me and Samir?

Thanks — attaching Retaillytics_Security_Checklist.pdf per request.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Retaillytics_Security_Checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@retaillytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval exchange: request for MAP + sample prompt pack

Elena — great, thanks for the clarifications and for the availability. Quick confirmation of how well proceed (finalized items and links):

1) Contract & MPA:
- Ive prepared a light MPA with the explicit no-export language you requested (includes downstream training prohibition).
- DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/for-signing/abcdef (Retaillytics & Redwood signatories)

2) Security evidence:
- SOC2 summary and our security portal link are here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (we will also attach the formal SOC2 letter in the DocuSign packet).

3) Artifacts & access:
- Prompt pack (read-only): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1promptpack (promptpack_v2.zip)
- Testcases metadata (CSV): included in the Drive folder above.
- Sandbox access: provisioned for two reviewers (elena.torres@retaillytics.com, samir.patel@retaillytics.com) from Apr 26 to May 10. Access credentials will be sent by Marissa (separate email).

4) Acceptance criteria & telemetry:
- Acceptance checklist included in Retaillytics_Eval_MAP_v1.pdf (we agreed pass = >=95% of critical testcases with no regression).
- Aggregated telemetry retention: 30 days post-sandbox teardown; Redwood will email confirmation of deletion by May 21.

Next steps (action owners):
- Jonas: send DocuSign to Retaillytics (today).
- Marissa: upload promptpack + testcases to Drive and provision sandbox accounts (by Apr 22).
- Retaillytics (Elena/Samir): sign MPA and confirm reviewers have received sandbox credentials.

If everything looks good Ill schedule the Apr 26 hand-off call for 10:00am PT and include Ben and Karthik on the technical deep-dive.
